name: ac-ledger
description: Ac记账 — 支持桌面端与 Web 端的记账软件，数据存储在 GitHub 仓库 / WebDAV

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ac-ledger/core && npm run build -w @ac-ledger/storage && npm run build -w @ac-ledger/bill-import
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ac-ledger/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/storage && tsc --noEmit -p packages/bill-import
